name: PTC India Ltd
title: PTC India Ltd - 532524 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Power trader PTC India: volumes up 12% to 92.8 BU in FY26 but margins flat and management guides to volume-led growth with no margin expansion; FY26 PAT flat at ₹397 crore ex-PEL sale.

triggers.label: Margins flat, decimal-point movement only
triggers.quote: Margins we don't expect to grow substantially. Marginal, you know, decimal percentage is plus and minus.

triggers.label: 70+ licensed traders on exchanges
triggers.quote: there are more than 70 licensed traders in the country currently.

triggers.label: Gross debtor days 51 → 44
triggers.quote: our gross debtor days has gone down from 51 days to 44 days

triggers.label: Volume +12% to 92.8 BU
triggers.quote: we did 92.8 billion units which is 12% more than last year.

guidance.value: In line with national ~5% electricity growth, a little higher
guidance.quote: we are expecting a 5% growth overall
Margins we don't expect to grow substantially.

red_flags.label: Net cash falling; PFS monetisation undecided
red_flags.quote: Net cash was on 31st March is around 2,800 crore and today should be around 2,400 crore

red_flags.label: Asset quality: distressed assets still being resolved
red_flags.quote: others in the near term, you will see them being resolved, so to say.

evasions.quote: Those configurations will emerge as a board committee and the board itself engages with us over the next few months.
in those three buckets I think we do not get more specific as of this point in time

evasions.topic: Asset quality of remaining stressed book
evasions.quote: I will not be able to speak on the specifics of that portfolio
